findings.summary: Starlette has missing Host header validation that poisons request.url.path, bypassing path-based security checks
Vulnerable OpenSSL included in cryptography wheels
cryptography: PKCS#7 EnvelopedData decryption exposes a Bleichenbacher oracle through distinguishable errors and timing
python-cryptography: Duplicate self-signed intermediates can cause exponential path-building
filelock ReadWriteLock: SQLite reopens the lock database by name, so a planted symlink or journal file makes the lock user's process overwrite or unlink its own files
MCP Python SDK: Experimental task handlers allow any client to access and cancel other clients' tasks
MCP Python SDK: HTTP transports serve session requests without verifying the authenticated principal
MCP Python SDK: WebSocket server transport does not support Host/Origin validation
python-multipart: Quadratic-time querystring parsing with semicolon separators causes CPU denial of service
python-multipart has Denial of Service via unbounded multipart part headers
Serena: Unauthenticated Flask dashboard on fixed port enables DNS rebinding → memory poisoning → RCE
Starlette: request.form() limits silently ignored for application/x-www-form-urlencoded enable DoS
Starlette: SSRF and NTLM credential theft via UNC paths in StaticFiles on Windows
urllib3: HTTPS proxy TLS configuration may be ignored or overridden
urllib3: Decompression-bomb safeguards bypassed in parts of the streaming API
urllib3: Sensitive headers forwarded across origins in proxied low-level redirects
urllib3: HTTPResponse.stream()/read_chunked() buffers an unbounded chunk-size line into memory
